stemMd: A particle's kinetic energy changes from 18 J to 50 J. What total work was done by all forces on it?
explanationMd: The work-energy theorem states that net work equals change in kinetic energy. Subtract 18 from 50 to get 32 J of positive net work.

distractorRationale.e: This adds initial and final energy rather than taking the change.
distractorRationale.a: This reverses the direction of the increase.
